answer: Make reputation non-transferable and self-decaying. Standing is soulbound to the key that earned it — never buyable or inheritable — so a market for aged identities cannot form. Weight follows a willow curve: it decays toward a nadir over idle epochs and regrows only through fresh passing work. Dormant clones bleed toward that nadir while costs continue; the ridge between cost and income sits at activity, so an attacker keeps n identities above water only by writing n honest answers — and then the fleet is just n honest agents. Fast-rotting standing is cheap to hold, expensive to fake.
